_说明_中文: 全局配置。修改后完整重启生效；只填写JSON配置值，以下_说明和_description字段仅供阅读。阶级独立属性、装备、AI、弹药与药水见roamer/tier1/tier2/tier3.json。
_description_en: Global configuration. Fully restart after editing. _说明 and _description fields are documentation only. Independent rank settings are in roamer/tier1/tier2/tier3.json.
_说明_vanilla_mode_中文: 原版模式，默认关闭；所有人类（含雇佣士兵）基础生命20、基础近战1并取消本模组近战/跳跃/三叉戟刺击倍率。武器、附魔、状态效果及外部生命修饰保留；原有远程倍率、护甲、AI与装备池规则不变。开启时统一成长整体停用并隐藏成长面板，保留已保存培养状态；不改写growth.enabled。完整重启生效，生命切换不额外治疗，超过新上限时截断。
_description_vanilla_mode_en: Default-off vanilla mode: all Humans use 20 base health and 1 base melee damage without this mod's melee/jump/trident-stab multipliers. Keep weapons, enchantments, effects, external health modifiers, existing ranged factors, armor, AI and equipment pools. Suppresses unified growth and its UI while preserving saved cultivation and the growth.enabled preference. Restart to apply; no free healing, clamp health to the new maximum.

hostile_mob_targeting._说明_中文: 敌对怪物主动发现本模组人类的统一入口，完整重启生效。仅补充选敌，移动、射击及攻击仍由原生AI负责；不保证独立Brain或仅攻击Player的特殊AI能够适配。野生及雇佣人类均可成为目标，遵守原生攻击许可、队伍和视线。
hostile_mob_targeting._description_en: Restart-scoped target discovery for hostile mobs. Movement and attacks remain native. Brain-based or Player-only AI may require dedicated integration. Both wild and hired Humans are eligible, respecting native attack permission, teams and sight.
hostile_mob_targeting._说明_enabled_中文: 默认开启；自动接入Enemy敌对类型，排除中立生物、可拥有的宠物及本模组人类。只在没有有效目标时搜索，不覆盖既有玩家或反击目标；搜索沿用原生随机节奏，范围不超过原生发现距离及32格。
hostile_mob_targeting._description_enabled_en: Default true. Auto-enroll Enemy mobs except NeutralMob, OwnableEntity and Humans. Discover targets only while no live target exists. Keep native randomized polling; range capped at native follow range and 32 blocks.
hostile_mob_targeting._说明_included_entities_中文: 额外明确接入的实体注册ID，例如modid:entity_id；适用于未标为Enemy的敌对Goal生物。此项可覆盖中立类型排除，不能覆盖宠物/人类排除或原生canAttack限制。默认空。
hostile_mob_targeting._description_included_entities_en: Explicit entity registry IDs for hostile Goal-based mobs not marked Enemy. Can opt in NeutralMob, but never OwnableEntity/Human or override native canAttack. Default empty.
hostile_mob_targeting._说明_excluded_entities_中文: 高优先级排除实体ID；存在AI冲突或不希望互相主动交战时填写。优先于自动识别和额外接入。默认空。
hostile_mob_targeting._description_excluded_entities_en: High-priority entity registry ID exclusions, overriding both auto-enrollment and explicit inclusions. Default empty.

tiers._说明_中文: 本阶独立设置；数量为物品个数，20 tick=1秒，2点生命=1颗心。
tiers._description_en: Independent rank settings; counts are items, 20 ticks=1 second, 2 health=1 heart.

roamer._说明_中文: 本阶独立设置；修改后完整重启，出生装备和补给只影响新生成的人类。
roamer._description_en: Independent rank settings; restart to apply. Spawn gear and supplies affect newly generated Humans.

attributes._description_en: Base entity attributes for this rank.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。
attributes._description_armor_en: Base armor, 0–30; equipped armor adds separately.
attributes._说明_knockback_resistance_中文: 基础击退抗性，0–1；1表示完全抵抗常规击退。
attributes._description_knockback_resistance_en: Base knockback resistance, 0–1; 1 fully resists normal knockback.
attributes._说明_follow_range_中文: 目标探测属性，8–128格；不是雇佣跟随的启停距离。
attributes._description_follow_range_en: Target detection attribute, 8–128 blocks; not the hired-follow start/stop distance.
attributes._说明_max_health_中文: 完整基础最大生命值，1–1024点；2点=1颗心。统一成长会乘阶段和经验百分比。
attributes._description_max_health_en: Full base maximum health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart. Unified growth applies stage and experience percentages.

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。
movement._description_en: Base movement attribute for the new speed formula (default 0.105, or 1.05x the normal player's base movement speed; range 0.01–0.2). Sprint and effects such as Speed use vanilla attribute modifiers.
movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.
movement._说明_follow_speed_multiplier_中文: 闲置雇佣跟随导航倍率，0.1–3，默认1.35。
movement._说明_follow_catch_up_multiplier_中文: 距离主人超过12格的追赶倍率，0.1–3，默认1.6；不会低于普通跟随倍率。
movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.

damage_multipliers._说明_中文: 本阶造成和承受的伤害倍率，各攻击类型独立。
damage_multipliers._description_en: Independent outgoing and incoming damage factors for this rank.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–100；武器、攻击属性与附魔计算后的伤害乘本值。原版模式跳过此倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output, 0–100; multiplies native weapon/attribute/enchantment damage. Bypassed in vanilla mode.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；只作用于弓，不改变速度或额外燃烧、药水效果。
damage_multipliers._description_bow_damage_multiplier_en: Rank bow direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes crossbows, velocity and separate fire/potion effects.
damage_multipliers._说明_crossbow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弩箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；包含斯巴达重弩。按弹射物发射来源区分，不受命中时换武器影响。
damage_multipliers._description_crossbow_damage_multiplier_: Rank crossbow direct-hit factor, 0–1000, including Spartan heavy crossbows. Classified by projectile origin rather than the weapon held at impact.
damage_multipliers._说明_thrown_trident_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶投掷三叉戟直接命中倍率，0–1000；不用于近刺。
damage_multipliers._description_thrown_trident_damage_multi: Rank thrown-trident direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes melee stabs.
damage_multipliers._说明_damage_taken_multiplier_中文: 本阶受到伤害的倍率，0–10；0可免除此层伤害，包括环境和枪伤。
damage_multipliers._description_damage_taken_multiplier_en: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

weapon_spread_degrees._说明_中文: 本阶TaCZ枪械及弓弩、三叉戟的独立散布角度；越小越精准。Scorched Guns使用原生精度，另受共用经验散布缩放影响。
weapon_spread_degrees._description_en: Rank aiming spread for TaCZ and ballistic weapons. Scorched Guns uses native accuracy with shared experience scaling.

firearms._说明_中文: 仅TaCZ枪械分类散布，不控制Scorched Guns。sniper=狙击枪，rifle=步枪，mg=机枪，pistol=手枪，smg=冲锋枪，shotgun=霰弹枪，other=其他。
firearms._description_en: TaCZ-only category spread; does not control Scorched Guns. Categories: sniper, rifle, mg, pistol, smg, shotgun and other.
firearms._说明_sniper_中文: 狙击枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_sniper_en: sniper spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_rifle_中文: 步枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_rifle_en: rifle spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_mg_中文: 机枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_mg_en: mg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_pistol_中文: 手枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_pistol_en: pistol spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_smg_中文: 冲锋枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_smg_en: smg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_shotgun_中文: 霰弹枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_shotgun_en: shotgun spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_other_中文: 其他枪种散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_other_en: other spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

projectiles._说明_中文: 弹射武器散布。bow=弓，crossbow=弩，trident=三叉戟；三类可分别设置。
projectiles._description_en: Projectile spread: bow, crossbow and trident are configured independently.
projectiles._说明_bow_中文: 弓散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_bow_en: bow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_crossbow_中文: 弩散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_crossbow_en: crossbow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_trident_中文: 三叉戟散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_trident_en: trident spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

combat._说明_中文: 近战攻击冷却随机范围，单位为游戏 tick（20 tick=1 秒）。
combat._description_en: Random melee attack cooldown range in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_min_中文: 近战随机冷却下限，1–200 tick；20 tick=1秒。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_min_en: Minimum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_max_中文: 近战随机冷却上限，1–200 tick；上下限倒置时自动交换。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_max_en: Maximum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; reversed bounds are swapped.

spawning._说明_中文: 本阶自然生成倍率与解锁日期。
spawning._description_en: Rank natural-spawn admission factor and unlock date.
spawning._说明_spawn_multiplier_中文: 普通自然生成准入倍率，0–100；与全局admission_chance相乘。0禁用本阶普通自然生成，不影响结构和召唤。 支持小数，不加引号或百分号；如0.1表示保留基础机会的10%。
spawning._description_spawn_multiplier_en: Ordinary natural-spawn admission factor, 0–100; multiplies global admission_chance. Zero excludes this rank from ordinary natural spawning, not structures or summons. Decimals are supported without quotes or percent signs; 0.1 retains 10% of baseline admission.
spawning._说明_first_spawn_day_中文: 本阶自然生成最早个人在线日，1–1000000整数；还需满足全局安全期和其他生成条件。
spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: Earliest personal online day for natural spawns of this rank, integer 1–1000000; global safety and other spawn rules still apply.

ammunition._说明_中文: 本阶新生远程职业的弹药储备，数量为个数。
ammunition._description_en: Initial ammunition reserves for this rank's ranged roles; counts are items.
ammunition._说明_arrows_中文: 新生弓/弩手通用箭矢数量范围；仅实际携带弓弩时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_arrows_en: Initial universal arrows for owned bows/crossbows; granted once, limited by inventory space.

arrows._说明_中文: 通用箭矢初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
arrows._description_en: Initial arrows for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
arrows._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–1920整数；0允许不配发。
arrows._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–1920; zero allows no supply.
arrows._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–1920整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
arrows._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–1920; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

ammunition._说明_magazines_中文: 新生枪手通用弹匣数量范围；仅实际携枪时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_magazines_en: Initial universal magazines for owned firearms; granted once, limited by inventory space.

magazines._说明_中文: 通用弹匣初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
magazines._description_en: Initial magazines for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
magazines._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–720整数；0允许不配发。
magazines._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–720; zero allows no supply.
magazines._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–720整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
magazines._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–720; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

food._说明_中文: 本阶一次性出生食物与金苹果。
food._description_en: One-time spawn food and golden apples for this rank.
food._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生食物、普通金苹果和附魔金苹果总开关。 还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
food._description_enabled_en: Spawn food and both apple types switch for this rank. Requires rank ai.item_recovery_enabled.
food._说明_variety_min_中文: 食物种类下限，1至30；受有效食物种类数限制。
food._description_variety_min_en: Minimum food varieties, 1-30, limited by available food types.
food._说明_variety_max_中文: 食物种类上限，1至30；上下限反填自动交换。
food._description_variety_max_en: Maximum food varieties, 1-30; reversed bounds are swapped.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_chance_中文: 附魔金苹果生成概率，0至1；设0完全不发放，不影响敌对信标的掉落限制。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_chan: Existence chance only; count is sampled from enchanted_golden_apple_counts. Independent of food scaling.
food._说明_presets_中文: 数量方案池：weight为相对正权重；count_min/max食物总数0至1920，golden_apple_min/max普通金苹果总数0至64。空方案池不发普通食物/普通金苹果；附魔金苹果另按概率控制。
food._description_presets_en: Weighted quantity presets: total food counts 0-1920 and golden-apple counts 0-64. Empty presets grant neither ordinary food nor golden apples; enchanted apples have a separate chance.
food._说明_pool_中文: 食物候选：item为注册食物物品ID，weight为正权重；按权重不重复选种类。不识别的物品和非食物跳过，空列表不回退。金苹果用上述专用数量项。
food._description_pool_en: Food candidates: registered edible item IDs and positive weights; varieties are sampled without replacement. Unavailable/nonfood items are skipped; empty lists grant no fallback. Use dedicated counts for apples.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_counts_中文: 出现判定后按数量权重抽取；不乘阵营食物倍率。三阶必有2或3颗，权重20:80。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_coun: Count weights after the appearance roll; independent of faction food multipliers. Tier three receives two or three with weights 20:80.

potions._说明_中文: 恢复药水、自身强化药水、投掷物分别独立计数和缩放，不共用总量。
potions._description_en: Independent recovery, self-buff and throwable totals and faction multipliers.
potions._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生药水发放开关；还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
potions._description_enabled_en: Spawn-potion switch for this rank; also requires ai.item_recovery_enabled.

recovery._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
recovery._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
recovery._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
recovery._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
recovery._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
recovery._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.

self_buffs._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
self_buffs._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

throwables._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
throwables._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

growth_profile._说明_start_day_中文: 个人在线成长起点日，1–1000000整数；离线、睡觉及/time不加速，与出生解锁独立。
growth_profile._description_start_day_en: Starting personal online day, integer 1–1000000; offline time, sleep and /time do not advance it; independent of spawn unlock.
growth_profile._说明_duration_days_中文: 达到完整品质所需个人在线日数，1–1000000整数；终点=起点+持续日数。
growth_profile._description_duration_days_en: Personal online days to full quality, integer 1–1000000; finish=start+duration.
growth_profile._说明_progress_nodes_中文: 持续时间20/40/60/80%处的成长进度，4个严格递增数字，均严格位于0与1之间；连接(0,0)与(1,1)分段线性插值。
growth_profile._description_progress_nodes_en: Progress at 20/40/60/80% of duration: four strictly increasing numbers strictly between 0 and 1; piecewise linear interpolation with endpoints (0,0) and (1,1).
growth_profile._说明_early_baseline_gear_chance_中文: 成长起点保留原装备材质的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_baseline_gear_chance_: Chance to retain baseline material at growth start, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_gun_chance_multiplier_中文: 成长起点的枪械携带概率倍率，0–1；乘本阶tacz.gun_chance。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_gun_chance_multiplier: Initial firearm chance multiplier, 0–1; multiplies rank tacz.gun_chance. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点每个非诅咒附魔的保留概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_keep_chan: Initial retention chance for each non-curse enchantment, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_level_multiplier_中: 成长起点附魔等级倍率，0–1，向下取整；0级移除。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_level_mul: Initial enchantment level multiplier, 0–1, rounded down; level 0 is removed. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_totem_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中不死图腾的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_totem_keep_chance_en: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled totem, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_trident_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中三叉戟的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_trident_keep_chance_e: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled trident, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_spartan_material_中文: 斯巴达武器早期材质前缀，例如wooden/stone；无对应物品使用安全回退。
growth_profile._description_early_spartan_material_en: Early Spartan material prefix, e.g. wooden/stone; unavailable items use safe fallbacks.
growth_profile._说明_early_melee_中文: 早期替换用剑/斧ID；必须符合武器类型。
growth_profile._description_early_melee_en: Early replacement sword/axe IDs; must match weapon types.

early_melee._说明_sword_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_melee._description_sword_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_melee._说明_axe_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_melee._description_axe_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

growth_profile._说明_early_armor_中文: 早期替换护甲ID；必须符合对应装备部位。
growth_profile._description_early_armor_en: Early replacement armor IDs; must match equipment slots.

early_armor._说明_head_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_head_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor.head: minecraft:leather_helmet
early_armor._说明_chest_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_chest_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor._说明_legs_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_legs_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor._说明_feet_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_feet_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

scguns._说明_中文: 焦燃与JEG共用分阶枪械池及伤害倍率；白名单中使用scguns:或jeg:完整ID。仅已安装后端读取其合格枪械；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制，但全局黑名单仍有效。
scguns._description_en: Independent Scorched Guns output factor for this rank.
scguns._说明_damage_multiplier_中文: 仅控制本阶人类使用Scorched Guns的枪伤，0–100，默认1.0；与TaCZ独立。全局联动倍率和战斗经验枪伤加成仍叠乘；原生NPC与玩家目标难度伤害缩放由全局人类枪伤规则替代。
scguns._description_damage_multiplier_en: Scorched Guns damage only, 0–100, default 1.0; independent of TaCZ. Global integration and combat experience factors still multiply; human-only global rules replace native NPC/player-target difficulty damage scaling.
scguns._说明_gun_whitelist_中文: 本阶出生枪械池，仅在全局scguns.spawn_pool_source为tier时读取；空池按该后端自动收录开关处理，不回退全局。非空仅使用正权重条目。全局黑名单优先；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制。
scguns._description_gun_whitelist_en: Rank birth gun pool, used only with global scguns.spawn_pool_source=tier. Empty follows backend discovery, never falls back to global; nonempty is strict. Global bans always win. Hired acceptance is independent.

tier1._说明_中文: 本阶独立设置；修改后完整重启，出生装备和补给只影响新生成的人类。
tier1._description_en: Independent rank settings; restart to apply. Spawn gear and supplies affect newly generated Humans.

attributes._description_en: Base entity attributes for this rank.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。
attributes._description_armor_en: Base armor, 0–30; equipped armor adds separately.
attributes._说明_knockback_resistance_中文: 基础击退抗性，0–1；1表示完全抵抗常规击退。
attributes._description_knockback_resistance_en: Base knockback resistance, 0–1; 1 fully resists normal knockback.
attributes._说明_follow_range_中文: 目标探测属性，8–128格；不是雇佣跟随的启停距离。
attributes._description_follow_range_en: Target detection attribute, 8–128 blocks; not the hired-follow start/stop distance.
attributes._说明_max_health_中文: 完整基础最大生命值，1–1024点；2点=1颗心。统一成长会乘阶段和经验百分比。
attributes._description_max_health_en: Full base maximum health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart. Unified growth applies stage and experience percentages.

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。
movement._description_en: Base movement attribute for the new speed formula (default 0.105, or 1.05x the normal player's base movement speed; range 0.01–0.2). Sprint and effects such as Speed use vanilla attribute modifiers.
movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.
movement._说明_follow_speed_multiplier_中文: 闲置雇佣跟随导航倍率，0.1–3，默认1.35。
movement._说明_follow_catch_up_multiplier_中文: 距离主人超过12格的追赶倍率，0.1–3，默认1.6；不会低于普通跟随倍率。
movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.

damage_multipliers._说明_中文: 本阶造成和承受的伤害倍率，各攻击类型独立。
damage_multipliers._description_en: Independent outgoing and incoming damage factors for this rank.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–100；武器、攻击属性与附魔计算后的伤害乘本值。原版模式跳过此倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output, 0–100; multiplies native weapon/attribute/enchantment damage. Bypassed in vanilla mode.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；只作用于弓，不改变速度或额外燃烧、药水效果。
damage_multipliers._description_bow_damage_multiplier_en: Rank bow direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes crossbows, velocity and separate fire/potion effects.
damage_multipliers._说明_crossbow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弩箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；包含斯巴达重弩。按弹射物发射来源区分，不受命中时换武器影响。
damage_multipliers._description_crossbow_damage_multiplier_: Rank crossbow direct-hit factor, 0–1000, including Spartan heavy crossbows. Classified by projectile origin rather than the weapon held at impact.
damage_multipliers._说明_thrown_trident_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶投掷三叉戟直接命中倍率，0–1000；不用于近刺。
damage_multipliers._description_thrown_trident_damage_multi: Rank thrown-trident direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes melee stabs.
damage_multipliers._说明_damage_taken_multiplier_中文: 本阶受到伤害的倍率，0–10；0可免除此层伤害，包括环境和枪伤。
damage_multipliers._description_damage_taken_multiplier_en: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

weapon_spread_degrees._说明_中文: 本阶TaCZ枪械及弓弩、三叉戟的独立散布角度；越小越精准。Scorched Guns使用原生精度，另受共用经验散布缩放影响。
weapon_spread_degrees._description_en: Rank aiming spread for TaCZ and ballistic weapons. Scorched Guns uses native accuracy with shared experience scaling.

firearms._说明_中文: 仅TaCZ枪械分类散布，不控制Scorched Guns。sniper=狙击枪，rifle=步枪，mg=机枪，pistol=手枪，smg=冲锋枪，shotgun=霰弹枪，other=其他。
firearms._description_en: TaCZ-only category spread; does not control Scorched Guns. Categories: sniper, rifle, mg, pistol, smg, shotgun and other.
firearms._说明_sniper_中文: 狙击枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_sniper_en: sniper spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_rifle_中文: 步枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_rifle_en: rifle spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_mg_中文: 机枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_mg_en: mg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_pistol_中文: 手枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_pistol_en: pistol spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_smg_中文: 冲锋枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_smg_en: smg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_shotgun_中文: 霰弹枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_shotgun_en: shotgun spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_other_中文: 其他枪种散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_other_en: other spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

projectiles._说明_中文: 弹射武器散布。bow=弓，crossbow=弩，trident=三叉戟；三类可分别设置。
projectiles._description_en: Projectile spread: bow, crossbow and trident are configured independently.
projectiles._说明_bow_中文: 弓散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_bow_en: bow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_crossbow_中文: 弩散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_crossbow_en: crossbow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_trident_中文: 三叉戟散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_trident_en: trident spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

combat._说明_中文: 近战攻击冷却随机范围，单位为游戏 tick（20 tick=1 秒）。
combat._description_en: Random melee attack cooldown range in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_min_中文: 近战随机冷却下限，1–200 tick；20 tick=1秒。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_min_en: Minimum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_max_中文: 近战随机冷却上限，1–200 tick；上下限倒置时自动交换。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_max_en: Maximum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; reversed bounds are swapped.

spawning._说明_中文: 本阶自然生成倍率与解锁日期。
spawning._description_en: Rank natural-spawn admission factor and unlock date.
spawning._说明_spawn_multiplier_中文: 普通自然生成准入倍率，0–100；与全局admission_chance相乘。0禁用本阶普通自然生成，不影响结构和召唤。 支持小数，不加引号或百分号；如0.1表示保留基础机会的10%。
spawning._description_spawn_multiplier_en: Ordinary natural-spawn admission factor, 0–100; multiplies global admission_chance. Zero excludes this rank from ordinary natural spawning, not structures or summons. Decimals are supported without quotes or percent signs; 0.1 retains 10% of baseline admission.
spawning._说明_first_spawn_day_中文: 本阶自然生成最早个人在线日，1–1000000整数；还需满足全局安全期和其他生成条件。
spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: Earliest personal online day for natural spawns of this rank, integer 1–1000000; global safety and other spawn rules still apply.

ammunition._说明_中文: 本阶新生远程职业的弹药储备，数量为个数。
ammunition._description_en: Initial ammunition reserves for this rank's ranged roles; counts are items.
ammunition._说明_arrows_中文: 新生弓/弩手通用箭矢数量范围；仅实际携带弓弩时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_arrows_en: Initial universal arrows for owned bows/crossbows; granted once, limited by inventory space.

arrows._说明_中文: 通用箭矢初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
arrows._description_en: Initial arrows for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
arrows._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–1920整数；0允许不配发。
arrows._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–1920; zero allows no supply.
arrows._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–1920整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
arrows._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–1920; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

ammunition._说明_magazines_中文: 新生枪手通用弹匣数量范围；仅实际携枪时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_magazines_en: Initial universal magazines for owned firearms; granted once, limited by inventory space.

magazines._说明_中文: 通用弹匣初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
magazines._description_en: Initial magazines for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
magazines._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–720整数；0允许不配发。
magazines._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–720; zero allows no supply.
magazines._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–720整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
magazines._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–720; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

food._说明_中文: 本阶一次性出生食物与金苹果。
food._description_en: One-time spawn food and golden apples for this rank.
food._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生食物、普通金苹果和附魔金苹果总开关。 还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
food._description_enabled_en: Spawn food and both apple types switch for this rank. Requires rank ai.item_recovery_enabled.
food._说明_variety_min_中文: 食物种类下限，1至30；受有效食物种类数限制。
food._description_variety_min_en: Minimum food varieties, 1-30, limited by available food types.
food._说明_variety_max_中文: 食物种类上限，1至30；上下限反填自动交换。
food._description_variety_max_en: Maximum food varieties, 1-30; reversed bounds are swapped.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_chance_中文: 附魔金苹果生成概率，0至1；设0完全不发放，不影响敌对信标的掉落限制。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_chan: Existence chance only; count is sampled from enchanted_golden_apple_counts. Independent of food scaling.
food._说明_presets_中文: 数量方案池：weight为相对正权重；count_min/max食物总数0至1920，golden_apple_min/max普通金苹果总数0至64。空方案池不发普通食物/普通金苹果；附魔金苹果另按概率控制。
food._description_presets_en: Weighted quantity presets: total food counts 0-1920 and golden-apple counts 0-64. Empty presets grant neither ordinary food nor golden apples; enchanted apples have a separate chance.
food._说明_pool_中文: 食物候选：item为注册食物物品ID，weight为正权重；按权重不重复选种类。不识别的物品和非食物跳过，空列表不回退。金苹果用上述专用数量项。
food._description_pool_en: Food candidates: registered edible item IDs and positive weights; varieties are sampled without replacement. Unavailable/nonfood items are skipped; empty lists grant no fallback. Use dedicated counts for apples.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_counts_中文: 出现判定后按数量权重抽取；不乘阵营食物倍率。三阶必有2或3颗，权重20:80。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_coun: Count weights after the appearance roll; independent of faction food multipliers. Tier three receives two or three with weights 20:80.

potions._说明_中文: 恢复药水、自身强化药水、投掷物分别独立计数和缩放，不共用总量。
potions._description_en: Independent recovery, self-buff and throwable totals and faction multipliers.
potions._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生药水发放开关；还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
potions._description_enabled_en: Spawn-potion switch for this rank; also requires ai.item_recovery_enabled.

recovery._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
recovery._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
recovery._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
recovery._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
recovery._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
recovery._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.

self_buffs._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
self_buffs._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

throwables._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
throwables._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

growth_profile._说明_start_day_中文: 个人在线成长起点日，1–1000000整数；离线、睡觉及/time不加速，与出生解锁独立。
growth_profile._description_start_day_en: Starting personal online day, integer 1–1000000; offline time, sleep and /time do not advance it; independent of spawn unlock.
growth_profile._说明_duration_days_中文: 达到完整品质所需个人在线日数，1–1000000整数；终点=起点+持续日数。
growth_profile._description_duration_days_en: Personal online days to full quality, integer 1–1000000; finish=start+duration.
growth_profile._说明_progress_nodes_中文: 持续时间20/40/60/80%处的成长进度，4个严格递增数字，均严格位于0与1之间；连接(0,0)与(1,1)分段线性插值。
growth_profile._description_progress_nodes_en: Progress at 20/40/60/80% of duration: four strictly increasing numbers strictly between 0 and 1; piecewise linear interpolation with endpoints (0,0) and (1,1).
growth_profile._说明_early_baseline_gear_chance_中文: 成长起点保留原装备材质的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_baseline_gear_chance_: Chance to retain baseline material at growth start, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_gun_chance_multiplier_中文: 成长起点的枪械携带概率倍率，0–1；乘本阶tacz.gun_chance。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_gun_chance_multiplier: Initial firearm chance multiplier, 0–1; multiplies rank tacz.gun_chance. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点每个非诅咒附魔的保留概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_keep_chan: Initial retention chance for each non-curse enchantment, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_level_multiplier_中: 成长起点附魔等级倍率，0–1，向下取整；0级移除。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_level_mul: Initial enchantment level multiplier, 0–1, rounded down; level 0 is removed. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_totem_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中不死图腾的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_totem_keep_chance_en: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled totem, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_trident_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中三叉戟的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_trident_keep_chance_e: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled trident, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_spartan_material_中文: 斯巴达武器早期材质前缀，例如wooden/stone；无对应物品使用安全回退。
growth_profile._description_early_spartan_material_en: Early Spartan material prefix, e.g. wooden/stone; unavailable items use safe fallbacks.
growth_profile._说明_early_melee_中文: 早期替换用剑/斧ID；必须符合武器类型。
growth_profile._description_early_melee_en: Early replacement sword/axe IDs; must match weapon types.

early_melee._说明_sword_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_melee._description_sword_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_melee._说明_axe_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_melee._description_axe_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

growth_profile._说明_early_armor_中文: 早期替换护甲ID；必须符合对应装备部位。
growth_profile._description_early_armor_en: Early replacement armor IDs; must match equipment slots.

early_armor._说明_head_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_head_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor.head: minecraft:leather_helmet
early_armor._说明_chest_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_chest_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor._说明_legs_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_legs_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor._说明_feet_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_feet_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

scguns._说明_中文: 焦燃与JEG共用分阶枪械池及伤害倍率；白名单中使用scguns:或jeg:完整ID。仅已安装后端读取其合格枪械；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制，但全局黑名单仍有效。
scguns._description_en: Independent Scorched Guns output factor for this rank.
scguns._说明_damage_multiplier_中文: 仅控制本阶人类使用Scorched Guns的枪伤，0–100，默认1.0；与TaCZ独立。全局联动倍率和战斗经验枪伤加成仍叠乘；原生NPC与玩家目标难度伤害缩放由全局人类枪伤规则替代。
scguns._description_damage_multiplier_en: Scorched Guns damage only, 0–100, default 1.0; independent of TaCZ. Global integration and combat experience factors still multiply; human-only global rules replace native NPC/player-target difficulty damage scaling.
scguns._说明_gun_whitelist_中文: 本阶出生枪械池，仅在全局scguns.spawn_pool_source为tier时读取；空池按该后端自动收录开关处理，不回退全局。非空仅使用正权重条目。全局黑名单优先；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制。
scguns._description_gun_whitelist_en: Rank birth gun pool, used only with global scguns.spawn_pool_source=tier. Empty follows backend discovery, never falls back to global; nonempty is strict. Global bans always win. Hired acceptance is independent.

tier2._说明_中文: 本阶独立设置；修改后完整重启，出生装备和补给只影响新生成的人类。
tier2._description_en: Independent rank settings; restart to apply. Spawn gear and supplies affect newly generated Humans.

attributes._description_en: Base entity attributes for this rank.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。
attributes._description_armor_en: Base armor, 0–30; equipped armor adds separately.
attributes._说明_knockback_resistance_中文: 基础击退抗性，0–1；1表示完全抵抗常规击退。
attributes._description_knockback_resistance_en: Base knockback resistance, 0–1; 1 fully resists normal knockback.
attributes._说明_follow_range_中文: 目标探测属性，8–128格；不是雇佣跟随的启停距离。
attributes._description_follow_range_en: Target detection attribute, 8–128 blocks; not the hired-follow start/stop distance.
attributes._说明_max_health_中文: 完整基础最大生命值，1–1024点；2点=1颗心。统一成长会乘阶段和经验百分比。
attributes._description_max_health_en: Full base maximum health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart. Unified growth applies stage and experience percentages.

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。
movement._description_en: Base movement attribute for the new speed formula (default 0.105, or 1.05x the normal player's base movement speed; range 0.01–0.2). Sprint and effects such as Speed use vanilla attribute modifiers.
movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.
movement._说明_follow_speed_multiplier_中文: 闲置雇佣跟随导航倍率，0.1–3，默认1.35。
movement._说明_follow_catch_up_multiplier_中文: 距离主人超过12格的追赶倍率，0.1–3，默认1.6；不会低于普通跟随倍率。
movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.

damage_multipliers._说明_中文: 本阶造成和承受的伤害倍率，各攻击类型独立。
damage_multipliers._description_en: Independent outgoing and incoming damage factors for this rank.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–100；武器、攻击属性与附魔计算后的伤害乘本值。原版模式跳过此倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output, 0–100; multiplies native weapon/attribute/enchantment damage. Bypassed in vanilla mode.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；只作用于弓，不改变速度或额外燃烧、药水效果。
damage_multipliers._description_bow_damage_multiplier_en: Rank bow direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes crossbows, velocity and separate fire/potion effects.
damage_multipliers._说明_crossbow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弩箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；包含斯巴达重弩。按弹射物发射来源区分，不受命中时换武器影响。
damage_multipliers._description_crossbow_damage_multiplier_: Rank crossbow direct-hit factor, 0–1000, including Spartan heavy crossbows. Classified by projectile origin rather than the weapon held at impact.
damage_multipliers._说明_thrown_trident_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶投掷三叉戟直接命中倍率，0–1000；不用于近刺。
damage_multipliers._description_thrown_trident_damage_multi: Rank thrown-trident direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes melee stabs.
damage_multipliers._说明_damage_taken_multiplier_中文: 本阶受到伤害的倍率，0–10；0可免除此层伤害，包括环境和枪伤。
damage_multipliers._description_damage_taken_multiplier_en: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

weapon_spread_degrees._说明_中文: 本阶TaCZ枪械及弓弩、三叉戟的独立散布角度；越小越精准。Scorched Guns使用原生精度，另受共用经验散布缩放影响。
weapon_spread_degrees._description_en: Rank aiming spread for TaCZ and ballistic weapons. Scorched Guns uses native accuracy with shared experience scaling.

firearms._说明_中文: 仅TaCZ枪械分类散布，不控制Scorched Guns。sniper=狙击枪，rifle=步枪，mg=机枪，pistol=手枪，smg=冲锋枪，shotgun=霰弹枪，other=其他。
firearms._description_en: TaCZ-only category spread; does not control Scorched Guns. Categories: sniper, rifle, mg, pistol, smg, shotgun and other.
firearms._说明_sniper_中文: 狙击枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_sniper_en: sniper spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_rifle_中文: 步枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_rifle_en: rifle spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_mg_中文: 机枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_mg_en: mg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_pistol_中文: 手枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_pistol_en: pistol spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_smg_中文: 冲锋枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_smg_en: smg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_shotgun_中文: 霰弹枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_shotgun_en: shotgun spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_other_中文: 其他枪种散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_other_en: other spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

projectiles._说明_中文: 弹射武器散布。bow=弓，crossbow=弩，trident=三叉戟；三类可分别设置。
projectiles._description_en: Projectile spread: bow, crossbow and trident are configured independently.
projectiles._说明_bow_中文: 弓散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_bow_en: bow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_crossbow_中文: 弩散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_crossbow_en: crossbow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_trident_中文: 三叉戟散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_trident_en: trident spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

combat._说明_中文: 近战攻击冷却随机范围，单位为游戏 tick（20 tick=1 秒）。
combat._description_en: Random melee attack cooldown range in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_min_中文: 近战随机冷却下限，1–200 tick；20 tick=1秒。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_min_en: Minimum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_max_中文: 近战随机冷却上限，1–200 tick；上下限倒置时自动交换。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_max_en: Maximum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; reversed bounds are swapped.

spawning._说明_中文: 本阶自然生成倍率与解锁日期。
spawning._description_en: Rank natural-spawn admission factor and unlock date.
spawning._说明_spawn_multiplier_中文: 普通自然生成准入倍率，0–100；与全局admission_chance相乘。0禁用本阶普通自然生成，不影响结构和召唤。 支持小数，不加引号或百分号；如0.1表示保留基础机会的10%。
spawning._description_spawn_multiplier_en: Ordinary natural-spawn admission factor, 0–100; multiplies global admission_chance. Zero excludes this rank from ordinary natural spawning, not structures or summons. Decimals are supported without quotes or percent signs; 0.1 retains 10% of baseline admission.
spawning._说明_first_spawn_day_中文: 本阶自然生成最早个人在线日，1–1000000整数；还需满足全局安全期和其他生成条件。
spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: Earliest personal online day for natural spawns of this rank, integer 1–1000000; global safety and other spawn rules still apply.

ammunition._说明_中文: 本阶新生远程职业的弹药储备，数量为个数。
ammunition._description_en: Initial ammunition reserves for this rank's ranged roles; counts are items.
ammunition._说明_arrows_中文: 新生弓/弩手通用箭矢数量范围；仅实际携带弓弩时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_arrows_en: Initial universal arrows for owned bows/crossbows; granted once, limited by inventory space.

arrows._说明_中文: 通用箭矢初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
arrows._description_en: Initial arrows for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
arrows._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–1920整数；0允许不配发。
arrows._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–1920; zero allows no supply.
arrows._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–1920整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
arrows._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–1920; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

ammunition._说明_magazines_中文: 新生枪手通用弹匣数量范围；仅实际携枪时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_magazines_en: Initial universal magazines for owned firearms; granted once, limited by inventory space.

magazines._说明_中文: 通用弹匣初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
magazines._description_en: Initial magazines for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
magazines._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–720整数；0允许不配发。
magazines._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–720; zero allows no supply.
magazines._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–720整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
magazines._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–720; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

food._说明_中文: 本阶一次性出生食物与金苹果。
food._description_en: One-time spawn food and golden apples for this rank.
food._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生食物、普通金苹果和附魔金苹果总开关。 还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
food._description_enabled_en: Spawn food and both apple types switch for this rank. Requires rank ai.item_recovery_enabled.
food._说明_variety_min_中文: 食物种类下限，1至30；受有效食物种类数限制。
food._description_variety_min_en: Minimum food varieties, 1-30, limited by available food types.
food._说明_variety_max_中文: 食物种类上限，1至30；上下限反填自动交换。
food._description_variety_max_en: Maximum food varieties, 1-30; reversed bounds are swapped.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_chance_中文: 附魔金苹果生成概率，0至1；设0完全不发放，不影响敌对信标的掉落限制。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_chan: Existence chance only; count is sampled from enchanted_golden_apple_counts. Independent of food scaling.
food._说明_presets_中文: 数量方案池：weight为相对正权重；count_min/max食物总数0至1920，golden_apple_min/max普通金苹果总数0至64。空方案池不发普通食物/普通金苹果；附魔金苹果另按概率控制。
food._description_presets_en: Weighted quantity presets: total food counts 0-1920 and golden-apple counts 0-64. Empty presets grant neither ordinary food nor golden apples; enchanted apples have a separate chance.
food._说明_pool_中文: 食物候选：item为注册食物物品ID，weight为正权重；按权重不重复选种类。不识别的物品和非食物跳过，空列表不回退。金苹果用上述专用数量项。
food._description_pool_en: Food candidates: registered edible item IDs and positive weights; varieties are sampled without replacement. Unavailable/nonfood items are skipped; empty lists grant no fallback. Use dedicated counts for apples.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_counts_中文: 出现判定后按数量权重抽取；不乘阵营食物倍率。三阶必有2或3颗，权重20:80。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_coun: Count weights after the appearance roll; independent of faction food multipliers. Tier three receives two or three with weights 20:80.

potions._说明_中文: 恢复药水、自身强化药水、投掷物分别独立计数和缩放，不共用总量。
potions._description_en: Independent recovery, self-buff and throwable totals and faction multipliers.
potions._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生药水发放开关；还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
potions._description_enabled_en: Spawn-potion switch for this rank; also requires ai.item_recovery_enabled.

recovery._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
recovery._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
recovery._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
recovery._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
recovery._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
recovery._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.

self_buffs._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
self_buffs._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

throwables._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
throwables._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

growth_profile._说明_start_day_中文: 个人在线成长起点日，1–1000000整数；离线、睡觉及/time不加速，与出生解锁独立。
growth_profile._description_start_day_en: Starting personal online day, integer 1–1000000; offline time, sleep and /time do not advance it; independent of spawn unlock.
growth_profile._说明_duration_days_中文: 达到完整品质所需个人在线日数，1–1000000整数；终点=起点+持续日数。
growth_profile._description_duration_days_en: Personal online days to full quality, integer 1–1000000; finish=start+duration.
growth_profile._说明_progress_nodes_中文: 持续时间20/40/60/80%处的成长进度，4个严格递增数字，均严格位于0与1之间；连接(0,0)与(1,1)分段线性插值。
growth_profile._description_progress_nodes_en: Progress at 20/40/60/80% of duration: four strictly increasing numbers strictly between 0 and 1; piecewise linear interpolation with endpoints (0,0) and (1,1).
growth_profile._说明_early_baseline_gear_chance_中文: 成长起点保留原装备材质的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_baseline_gear_chance_: Chance to retain baseline material at growth start, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_gun_chance_multiplier_中文: 成长起点的枪械携带概率倍率，0–1；乘本阶tacz.gun_chance。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_gun_chance_multiplier: Initial firearm chance multiplier, 0–1; multiplies rank tacz.gun_chance. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点每个非诅咒附魔的保留概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_keep_chan: Initial retention chance for each non-curse enchantment, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_level_multiplier_中: 成长起点附魔等级倍率，0–1，向下取整；0级移除。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_level_mul: Initial enchantment level multiplier, 0–1, rounded down; level 0 is removed. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_totem_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中不死图腾的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_totem_keep_chance_en: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled totem, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_trident_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中三叉戟的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_trident_keep_chance_e: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled trident, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_spartan_material_中文: 斯巴达武器早期材质前缀，例如wooden/stone；无对应物品使用安全回退。
growth_profile._description_early_spartan_material_en: Early Spartan material prefix, e.g. wooden/stone; unavailable items use safe fallbacks.
growth_profile._说明_early_melee_中文: 早期替换用剑/斧ID；必须符合武器类型。
growth_profile._description_early_melee_en: Early replacement sword/axe IDs; must match weapon types.

early_melee._说明_sword_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_melee._description_sword_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_melee._说明_axe_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_melee._description_axe_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

growth_profile._说明_early_armor_中文: 早期替换护甲ID；必须符合对应装备部位。
growth_profile._description_early_armor_en: Early replacement armor IDs; must match equipment slots.

early_armor._说明_head_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_head_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor.head: minecraft:iron_helmet
early_armor._说明_chest_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_chest_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor._说明_legs_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_legs_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.
early_armor._说明_feet_中文: 早期替换用注册物品ID；须符合该武器类型或护甲部位，无效ID使用安全回退。
early_armor._description_feet_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

scguns._说明_中文: 焦燃与JEG共用分阶枪械池及伤害倍率；白名单中使用scguns:或jeg:完整ID。仅已安装后端读取其合格枪械；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制，但全局黑名单仍有效。
scguns._description_en: Independent Scorched Guns output factor for this rank.
scguns._说明_damage_multiplier_中文: 仅控制本阶人类使用Scorched Guns的枪伤，0–100，默认1.0；与TaCZ独立。全局联动倍率和战斗经验枪伤加成仍叠乘；原生NPC与玩家目标难度伤害缩放由全局人类枪伤规则替代。
scguns._description_damage_multiplier_en: Scorched Guns damage only, 0–100, default 1.0; independent of TaCZ. Global integration and combat experience factors still multiply; human-only global rules replace native NPC/player-target difficulty damage scaling.
scguns._说明_gun_whitelist_中文: 本阶出生枪械池，仅在全局scguns.spawn_pool_source为tier时读取；空池按该后端自动收录开关处理，不回退全局。非空仅使用正权重条目。全局黑名单优先；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制。
scguns._description_gun_whitelist_en: Rank birth gun pool, used only with global scguns.spawn_pool_source=tier. Empty follows backend discovery, never falls back to global; nonempty is strict. Global bans always win. Hired acceptance is independent.

tier3._说明_中文: 本阶独立设置；修改后完整重启，出生装备和补给只影响新生成的人类。
tier3._description_en: Independent rank settings; restart to apply. Spawn gear and supplies affect newly generated Humans.

attributes._description_en: Base entity attributes for this rank.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。
attributes._description_armor_en: Base armor, 0–30; equipped armor adds separately.
attributes._说明_knockback_resistance_中文: 基础击退抗性，0–1；1表示完全抵抗常规击退。
attributes._description_knockback_resistance_en: Base knockback resistance, 0–1; 1 fully resists normal knockback.
attributes._说明_follow_range_中文: 目标探测属性，8–128格；不是雇佣跟随的启停距离。
attributes._description_follow_range_en: Target detection attribute, 8–128 blocks; not the hired-follow start/stop distance.
attributes._说明_max_health_中文: 完整基础最大生命值，1–1024点；2点=1颗心。统一成长会乘阶段和经验百分比。
attributes._description_max_health_en: Full base maximum health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart. Unified growth applies stage and experience percentages.

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。
movement._description_en: Base movement attribute for the new speed formula (default 0.105, or 1.05x the normal player's base movement speed; range 0.01–0.2). Sprint and effects such as Speed use vanilla attribute modifiers.
movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.
movement._说明_follow_speed_multiplier_中文: 闲置雇佣跟随导航倍率，0.1–3，默认1.35。
movement._说明_follow_catch_up_multiplier_中文: 距离主人超过12格的追赶倍率，0.1–3，默认1.6；不会低于普通跟随倍率。
movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.

damage_multipliers._说明_中文: 本阶造成和承受的伤害倍率，各攻击类型独立。
damage_multipliers._description_en: Independent outgoing and incoming damage factors for this rank.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–100；武器、攻击属性与附魔计算后的伤害乘本值。原版模式跳过此倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output, 0–100; multiplies native weapon/attribute/enchantment damage. Bypassed in vanilla mode.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；只作用于弓，不改变速度或额外燃烧、药水效果。
damage_multipliers._description_bow_damage_multiplier_en: Rank bow direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes crossbows, velocity and separate fire/potion effects.
damage_multipliers._说明_crossbow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弩箭直接命中倍率，0–1000；包含斯巴达重弩。按弹射物发射来源区分，不受命中时换武器影响。
damage_multipliers._description_crossbow_damage_multiplier_: Rank crossbow direct-hit factor, 0–1000, including Spartan heavy crossbows. Classified by projectile origin rather than the weapon held at impact.
damage_multipliers._说明_thrown_trident_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶投掷三叉戟直接命中倍率，0–1000；不用于近刺。
damage_multipliers._description_thrown_trident_damage_multi: Rank thrown-trident direct-hit factor, 0–1000; excludes melee stabs.
damage_multipliers._说明_damage_taken_multiplier_中文: 本阶受到伤害的倍率，0–10；0可免除此层伤害，包括环境和枪伤。
damage_multipliers._description_damage_taken_multiplier_en: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

weapon_spread_degrees._说明_中文: 本阶TaCZ枪械及弓弩、三叉戟的独立散布角度；越小越精准。Scorched Guns使用原生精度，另受共用经验散布缩放影响。
weapon_spread_degrees._description_en: Rank aiming spread for TaCZ and ballistic weapons. Scorched Guns uses native accuracy with shared experience scaling.

firearms._说明_中文: 仅TaCZ枪械分类散布，不控制Scorched Guns。sniper=狙击枪，rifle=步枪，mg=机枪，pistol=手枪，smg=冲锋枪，shotgun=霰弹枪，other=其他。
firearms._description_en: TaCZ-only category spread; does not control Scorched Guns. Categories: sniper, rifle, mg, pistol, smg, shotgun and other.
firearms._说明_sniper_中文: 狙击枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_sniper_en: sniper spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_rifle_中文: 步枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_rifle_en: rifle spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_mg_中文: 机枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_mg_en: mg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_pistol_中文: 手枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_pistol_en: pistol spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_smg_中文: 冲锋枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_smg_en: smg spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_shotgun_中文: 霰弹枪散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_shotgun_en: shotgun spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
firearms._说明_other_中文: 其他枪种散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
firearms._description_other_en: other spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

projectiles._说明_中文: 弹射武器散布。bow=弓，crossbow=弩，trident=三叉戟；三类可分别设置。
projectiles._description_en: Projectile spread: bow, crossbow and trident are configured independently.
projectiles._说明_bow_中文: 弓散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_bow_en: bow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_crossbow_中文: 弩散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_crossbow_en: crossbow spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.
projectiles._说明_trident_中文: 三叉戟散布角度，0–45度；越小越精准。
projectiles._description_trident_en: trident spread in degrees, 0–45; smaller is more accurate.

combat._说明_中文: 近战攻击冷却随机范围，单位为游戏 tick（20 tick=1 秒）。
combat._description_en: Random melee attack cooldown range in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_min_中文: 近战随机冷却下限，1–200 tick；20 tick=1秒。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_min_en: Minimum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_max_中文: 近战随机冷却上限，1–200 tick；上下限倒置时自动交换。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_max_en: Maximum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; reversed bounds are swapped.

spawning._说明_中文: 本阶自然生成倍率与解锁日期。
spawning._description_en: Rank natural-spawn admission factor and unlock date.
spawning._说明_spawn_multiplier_中文: 普通自然生成准入倍率，0–100；与全局admission_chance相乘。0禁用本阶普通自然生成，不影响结构和召唤。 支持小数，不加引号或百分号；如0.1表示保留基础机会的10%。
spawning._description_spawn_multiplier_en: Ordinary natural-spawn admission factor, 0–100; multiplies global admission_chance. Zero excludes this rank from ordinary natural spawning, not structures or summons. Decimals are supported without quotes or percent signs; 0.1 retains 10% of baseline admission.
spawning._说明_first_spawn_day_中文: 本阶自然生成最早个人在线日，1–1000000整数；还需满足全局安全期和其他生成条件。
spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: Earliest personal online day for natural spawns of this rank, integer 1–1000000; global safety and other spawn rules still apply.

ammunition._说明_中文: 本阶新生远程职业的弹药储备，数量为个数。
ammunition._description_en: Initial ammunition reserves for this rank's ranged roles; counts are items.
ammunition._说明_arrows_中文: 新生弓/弩手通用箭矢数量范围；仅实际携带弓弩时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_arrows_en: Initial universal arrows for owned bows/crossbows; granted once, limited by inventory space.

arrows._说明_中文: 通用箭矢初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
arrows._description_en: Initial arrows for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
arrows._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–1920整数；0允许不配发。
arrows._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–1920; zero allows no supply.
arrows._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–1920整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
arrows._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–1920; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

ammunition._说明_magazines_中文: 新生枪手通用弹匣数量范围；仅实际携枪时配发一次，受背包空间限制。
ammunition._description_magazines_en: Initial universal magazines for owned firearms; granted once, limited by inventory space.

magazines._说明_中文: 通用弹匣初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
magazines._description_en: Initial magazines for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.
magazines._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–720整数；0允许不配发。
magazines._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–720; zero allows no supply.
magazines._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–720整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
magazines._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–720; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.

food._说明_中文: 本阶一次性出生食物与金苹果。
food._description_en: One-time spawn food and golden apples for this rank.
food._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生食物、普通金苹果和附魔金苹果总开关。 还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
food._description_enabled_en: Spawn food and both apple types switch for this rank. Requires rank ai.item_recovery_enabled.
food._说明_variety_min_中文: 食物种类下限，1至30；受有效食物种类数限制。
food._description_variety_min_en: Minimum food varieties, 1-30, limited by available food types.
food._说明_variety_max_中文: 食物种类上限，1至30；上下限反填自动交换。
food._description_variety_max_en: Maximum food varieties, 1-30; reversed bounds are swapped.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_chance_中文: 附魔金苹果生成概率，0至1；设0完全不发放，不影响敌对信标的掉落限制。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_chan: Existence chance only; count is sampled from enchanted_golden_apple_counts. Independent of food scaling.
food._说明_presets_中文: 数量方案池：weight为相对正权重；count_min/max食物总数0至1920，golden_apple_min/max普通金苹果总数0至64。空方案池不发普通食物/普通金苹果；附魔金苹果另按概率控制。
food._description_presets_en: Weighted quantity presets: total food counts 0-1920 and golden-apple counts 0-64. Empty presets grant neither ordinary food nor golden apples; enchanted apples have a separate chance.
food._说明_pool_中文: 食物候选：item为注册食物物品ID，weight为正权重；按权重不重复选种类。不识别的物品和非食物跳过，空列表不回退。金苹果用上述专用数量项。
food._description_pool_en: Food candidates: registered edible item IDs and positive weights; varieties are sampled without replacement. Unavailable/nonfood items are skipped; empty lists grant no fallback. Use dedicated counts for apples.
food._说明_enchanted_golden_apple_counts_中文: 出现判定后按数量权重抽取；不乘阵营食物倍率。三阶必有2或3颗，权重20:80。
food._description_enchanted_golden_apple_coun: Count weights after the appearance roll; independent of faction food multipliers. Tier three receives two or three with weights 20:80.

potions._说明_中文: 恢复药水、自身强化药水、投掷物分别独立计数和缩放，不共用总量。
potions._description_en: Independent recovery, self-buff and throwable totals and faction multipliers.
potions._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生药水发放开关；还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
potions._description_enabled_en: Spawn-potion switch for this rank; also requires ai.item_recovery_enabled.

recovery._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
recovery._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
recovery._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
recovery._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
recovery._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
recovery._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.

self_buffs._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
self_buffs._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

throwables._说明_中文: 独立出生总量；先乘本类阵营倍率，再按大类和类内权重抽取；空池不补回。
throwables._description_en: Independent spawn total and faction multiplier. Category then member weighted draws; an empty pool grants none.

growth_profile._说明_start_day_中文: 个人在线成长起点日，1–1000000整数；离线、睡觉及/time不加速，与出生解锁独立。
growth_profile._description_start_day_en: Starting personal online day, integer 1–1000000; offline time, sleep and /time do not advance it; independent of spawn unlock.
growth_profile._说明_duration_days_中文: 达到完整品质所需个人在线日数，1–1000000整数；终点=起点+持续日数。
growth_profile._description_duration_days_en: Personal online days to full quality, integer 1–1000000; finish=start+duration.
growth_profile._说明_progress_nodes_中文: 持续时间20/40/60/80%处的成长进度，4个严格递增数字，均严格位于0与1之间；连接(0,0)与(1,1)分段线性插值。
growth_profile._description_progress_nodes_en: Progress at 20/40/60/80% of duration: four strictly increasing numbers strictly between 0 and 1; piecewise linear interpolation with endpoints (0,0) and (1,1).
growth_profile._说明_early_baseline_gear_chance_中文: 成长起点保留原装备材质的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_baseline_gear_chance_: Chance to retain baseline material at growth start, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_gun_chance_multiplier_中文: 成长起点的枪械携带概率倍率，0–1；乘本阶tacz.gun_chance。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_gun_chance_multiplier: Initial firearm chance multiplier, 0–1; multiplies rank tacz.gun_chance. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点每个非诅咒附魔的保留概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_keep_chan: Initial retention chance for each non-curse enchantment, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_enchantment_level_multiplier_中: 成长起点附魔等级倍率，0–1，向下取整；0级移除。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_enchantment_level_mul: Initial enchantment level multiplier, 0–1, rounded down; level 0 is removed. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_totem_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中不死图腾的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_totem_keep_chance_en: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled totem, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_trident_keep_chance_中文: 成长起点保留已抽中三叉戟的概率，0–1。 随成长进度p线性提高至1：实际值=本值+(1-本值)×p。
growth_profile._description_early_trident_keep_chance_e: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled trident, 0–1. Interpolates to 1 with progress p: effective=value+(1-value)*p.
growth_profile._说明_early_spartan_material_中文: 斯巴达武器早期材质前缀，例如wooden/stone；无对应物品使用安全回退。
growth_profile._description_early_spartan_material_en: Early Spartan material prefix, e.g. wooden/stone; unavailable items use safe fallbacks.
growth_profile._说明_early_melee_中文: 早期替换用剑/斧ID；必须符合武器类型。
growth_profile._description_early_melee_en: Early replacement sword/axe IDs; must match weapon types.

early_melee._description_sword_en: Registered early replacement item ID; must match the weapon type/armor slot. Invalid IDs use a safe fallback.

growth_profile._description_early_armor_en: Early replacement armor IDs; must match equipment slots.

scguns._说明_中文: 焦燃与JEG共用分阶枪械池及伤害倍率；白名单中使用scguns:或jeg:完整ID。仅已安装后端读取其合格枪械；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制，但全局黑名单仍有效。
scguns._description_en: Independent Scorched Guns output factor for this rank.
scguns._说明_damage_multiplier_中文: 仅控制本阶人类使用Scorched Guns的枪伤，0–100，默认1.0；与TaCZ独立。全局联动倍率和战斗经验枪伤加成仍叠乘；原生NPC与玩家目标难度伤害缩放由全局人类枪伤规则替代。
scguns._description_damage_multiplier_en: Scorched Guns damage only, 0–100, default 1.0; independent of TaCZ. Global integration and combat experience factors still multiply; human-only global rules replace native NPC/player-target difficulty damage scaling.
scguns._说明_gun_whitelist_中文: 本阶出生枪械池，仅在全局scguns.spawn_pool_source为tier时读取；空池按该后端自动收录开关处理，不回退全局。非空仅使用正权重条目。全局黑名单优先；雇佣后不受出生白名单限制。
scguns._description_gun_whitelist_en: Rank birth gun pool, used only with global scguns.spawn_pool_source=tier. Empty follows backend discovery, never falls back to global; nonempty is strict. Global bans always win. Hired acceptance is independent.

damage._说明_中文: 仅在命中特定条件时叠加的伤害修正。各阶基础输出倍率在各阶文件设置。
damage._description_en: Conditional hit modifiers only. Base Human output belongs to rank files.
damage._说明_trident_stab_damage_multiplier_中文: 手持三叉戟近刺的附加倍率，0–10；乘本阶近战输出倍率，不影响投掷。
damage._description_trident_stab_damage_multipl: Additional held-trident melee-stab factor, 0–10; multiplies rank melee output, not throws.
damage._说明_human_melee_vs_tamed_maid_multiplier: 人类近战命中已驯服女仆时的额外倍率，0–10，默认0.25；不是女仆的攻击输出。
damage._description_human_melee_vs_tamed_maid_m: Additional factor for Human melee hits against tamed maids, 0–10, default 0.25; does not scale maid attack output.
damage._说明_armor_penetration_enabled_中文: 启用人类攻击的统一穿甲比例转换，仅直接武器/弹射攻击；不转换环境和持续伤害。
damage._description_armor_penetration_enabled_e: Enable shared penetration conversion for direct Human weapon/projectile attacks, excluding environment and damage over time.
damage._说明_armor_penetration_curve_中文: 穿甲转换指数，默认1为线性；应用上限45%。此项是可调实现默认。
damage._description_armor_penetration_curve_en: Penetration conversion exponent, default 1 (linear), capped at 45%; adjustable implementation default.
damage._说明_passive_shield_before_armor_中文: 被动盾普通段在护甲前结算（true，默认）或护甲后结算（false）；穿甲段均跳过。
damage._description_passive_shield_before_armor: Apply passive shield to normal damage before armor (true, default) or after armor (false); penetration bypasses it.
damage._说明_shield_durability_rate_per_damage_中文: 每点实际格挡伤害按盾最大耐久追加的损耗系数，默认0.0015（0.15%）；仍汇总霰弹并计基础损耗。
damage._description_shield_durability_rate_per_: Additional maximum-shield-durability wear per blocked damage, default 0.0015 (0.15%); retains pellet aggregation and base wear.

equipment_integration._说明_中文: 武器装备自动导入总开关。只控制启动时是否向装备池追加已安装模组的默认联动装备，不控制动画兼容和物品使用。修改后重启生效。
equipment_integration._description_en: Master switch for startup equipment imports. Controls additive discovery of default equipment from installed mods, not animations or item use. Restart to apply.
equipment_integration._说明_auto_import_enabled_中文: 默认true。开启时按阶追加首次导入的斯巴达武器/盾牌及沉浸式盔甲套装，保留自定义条目及其权重、空池和已有导入记录；关闭后不追加或改写装备池，也不删除已有条目。分阶automatic_spartan_weapons/shields及automatic_immersive_armors仍分别控制导入。
equipment_integration._description_auto_import_enabled_en: Default true. Add first-time Spartan weapon/shield and Immersive Armors imports by rank while preserving custom rows/weights, empty pools and receipts. False prevents pool imports/writes without removing existing rows. Per-rank Spartan and Immersive Armors switches still apply.

combat_resupply._说明_中文: 正式雇佣且已开启士兵拾取时，战斗或撤退中只顺路收集短缺的弹药与恢复用品。无搜刮寻路、不转头、不清仇恨、不换手、不打断装填或举盾。只收附近无遮挡、高差不超过1格且无需下潜的补给；服从命令范围、背包保留和使用托管槽位。
combat_resupply._description_en: Hired soldiers with pickup enabled collect only needed nearby supplies during combat/retreat. No looting path, look/target/hand changes or interrupted defense/reload. Requires unobstructed reach, at most one block of vertical difference and no diving; order limits and reserved inventory slots apply.
combat_resupply._说明_enabled_中文: 战斗补给总开关；还必须开启该士兵自己的物品拾取。
combat_resupply._description_enabled_en: Combat resupply switch; the soldier's own pickup permission is also required.
combat_resupply._说明_arrow_low_中文: 拥有弓弩且通用箭矢剩余不超过此数时开始顺路补给；临时切近战也检查背包武器。关闭弹药消耗时不补弹药。
combat_resupply._description_arrow_low_en: Begin arrow resupply at or below this reserve, including bows stored during temporary melee. Ammunition-free mode disables ammo resupply.
combat_resupply._说明_arrow_target_中文: 一次短缺补给持续到此箭矢余量，默认32，至少比触发值多1；只取缺少数量，余下留在地面。
combat_resupply._description_arrow_target_en: Stop an arrow resupply cycle at this reserve; at least one above arrow_low. Collect only the missing amount.
combat_resupply._说明_magazine_target_reloads_中文: 通用弹匣少于所拥有可用枪械的最高单次费用时触发，补到该费用乘此次数，默认2轮；不因暂时持近战而忘记枪械。
combat_resupply._description_magazine_target_reloads_en: Trigger below the highest reload cost among owned accepted guns; refill reserves to that cost times this number of cycles. Temporary melee does not remove gun ownership.
combat_resupply._说明_recovery_items_per_pickup_中文: 没有食物、治疗/再生饮用药水或已接入恢复药品，且无正在使用或生效的恢复时，一次最多收此数量的恢复用品。暂时药品冷却不算库存耗尽；不收纯战术增益药品。
combat_resupply._description_recovery_items_per_pickup_e: Maximum recovery items per pickup when no physical healing reserves or active recovery remain. Temporary cooldowns are not exhaustion; purely tactical buffs do not qualify.
combat_resupply._说明_radius_中文: 顺路拾取半径，默认2格，范围0.5–2.5；不会为了半径内物品启动导航。
combat_resupply._description_radius_en: Nearby reach in blocks, default 2, range 0.5-2.5. Never starts navigation.
combat_resupply._说明_interval_ticks_中文: 短缺检查间隔，默认20tick即1秒，范围10–200。按实体错峰；最多检查16个附近候选，每轮最多成功收取一处，失败候选暂缓40tick。
combat_resupply._description_interval_ticks_en: Staggered check interval, default 20 ticks (one second), range 10-200. At most 16 nearby candidates and one successful pickup per pass; rejected candidates wait 40 ticks.

armor_swap._说明_中文: 护甲自动换装：背包优化与地面直接装备共用规则；完整品质不含磨损，拾取价值仍按耐久折价。玩家手动锁定优先。仅自动换装计冷却，每个槽独立；空槽和应急更换不受冷却限制。完整重启生效。
armor_swap._说明_upgrade_min_gain_percent_中文: 普通升级需要完整品质至少提高此百分比；品质相同不算升级。范围0–100。
armor_swap._说明_upgrade_min_durability_percent_中文: 普通品质升级的候选护甲最低剩余耐久百分比。范围0–100。
armor_swap._说明_replace_below_durability_percent_中文: 当前护甲剩余耐久不高于此百分比时，允许换同等或更高完整品质且更耐用的护甲。范围0–100。
armor_swap._说明_replacement_durability_advantage_per: 耐久补换候选至少多出的剩余耐久百分点，不是相对百分比；候选必须严格更耐用。范围0–100。
armor_swap._说明_emergency_below_durability_percent_中: 当前剩余耐久不高于此百分比时，应急更换可绕过冷却；自动限制为不高于普通耐久补换阈值。范围0–100。
armor_swap._说明_emergency_min_quality_percent_中文: 应急候选完整品质至少为当前护甲的此百分比，默认最多牺牲20%品质；仍须满足耐久优势。范围0–100。
armor_swap._说明_cooldown_ticks_中文: 每个护甲槽自动换装冷却，20tick=1秒；仅成功换装后开始，空槽/应急/手动操作不受限制。0–12000，非整数向下取整。
armor_swap._description_upgrade_min_gain_percent_en: Minimum full-quality gain percent for ordinary armor upgrades.
armor_swap._description_upgrade_min_durability_perc: Minimum remaining durability percent for an ordinary armor upgrade.
armor_swap._description_replace_below_durability_pe: Allow replacement when equipped armor falls below this remaining durability percent.
armor_swap._description_replacement_durability_adva: Required remaining-durability advantage in percentage points for a replacement.
armor_swap._description_emergency_below_durability_: Emergency replacement threshold in remaining durability percent.
armor_swap._description_emergency_min_quality_perce: Minimum full-quality percent of current armor accepted in an emergency.
armor_swap._description_cooldown_ticks_en: Independent automatic armor replacement cooldown per slot, in ticks.

roamer._说明_中文: 本阶生成装备；池中使用注册物品ID与正权重，空池保持为空。 阵营概率/档位/附魔/补给按独立内置表；可用faction_overrides逐阵营覆盖。新gun_chance是唯一枪械概率；旧tacz.gun_chance仅首次显式迁移。
roamer._description_en: Spawn equipment for this rank. Pools use registered item IDs and positive weights; empty pools remain empty. Faction policies use the built-in table. Override via faction_overrides. gun_chance is the only gun probability; explicit legacy tacz.gun_chance migrates once.
roamer._说明_mainhand_中文: 近战主手候选池，按正权重抽取一个。
roamer._description_mainhand_en: Melee main-hand pool; select one using positive relative weights.
roamer._说明_ranged_mainhand_中文: 弓弩主手候选池；枪械生成不在此列表设置。
roamer._description_ranged_mainhand_en: Bow/crossbow main-hand pool; firearm generation is configured separately.
roamer._说明_offhand_中文: 副手生成概率chance及候选entries；远程职业盾牌遵循兼容规则。
roamer._description_offhand_en: Off-hand chance and entries; ranged shields follow compatibility rules.

offhand._说明_entries_中文: 候选列表：item为注册物品ID，weight为正权重；可填空列表。
offhand._description_entries_en: Candidate list: registered item ID in item, positive weight in weight; an empty list is allowed.

roamer._说明_inventory_中文: 背包备用武器候选池；现有数量规则保持。
roamer._description_inventory_en: Backpack backup-weapon pool; existing count rules apply.
roamer._说明_bonus_mainhand_中文: 额外武器槽候选：chance为0–1概率，entries为权重池；不替换已生成主手。
roamer._description_bonus_mainhand_en: Bonus weapon-slot selection: chance 0–1 and weighted entries; does not replace the generated main hand.

bonus_mainhand._说明_entries_中文: 候选列表：item为注册物品ID，weight为正权重；可填空列表。
bonus_mainhand._description_entries_en: Candidate list: registered item ID in item, positive weight in weight; an empty list is allowed.

roamer._说明_armor_sets_中文: 整套护甲池：weight为正权重，head/chest/legs/feet为各部位物品ID；requires_mod可限定前置。
roamer._description_armor_sets_en: Armor-set pool: positive weight, head/chest/legs/feet item IDs; optional requires_mod dependency.
roamer._说明_ranged_in_backpack_中文: 将生成的非枪械远程武器放入背包，而不是主手；仍计入武器数量上限。
roamer._description_ranged_in_backpack_en: Place non-firearm ranged weapons in the backpack instead of the main hand; still counts toward the weapon cap.
roamer._说明_automatic_spartan_weapons_中文: 是否自动导入可用斯巴达武器；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制；启动注册表就绪后追加，保留自定义条目/权重，空池及已有导入记录不补回。
roamer._description_automatic_spartan_weapons_e: Import available Spartan weapons additively once registries are ready, under the global equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled switch. Back up existing files and preserve custom entries/weights, empty pools and completed imports.
roamer._说明_automatic_spartan_shields_中文: 是否自动导入可用斯巴达盾牌；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制；启动注册表就绪后追加，保留自定义条目/权重，空池及已有导入记录不补回。
roamer._description_automatic_spartan_shields_e: Import available Spartan shields additively once registries are ready, under the global equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled switch. Back up existing files and preserve custom entries/weights, empty pools and completed imports.
roamer._说明_automatic_immersive_armors_中文: 是否首次自动导入本阶默认沉浸式盔甲套装；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制，保留自定义套装、权重、空池和导入记录。
roamer._description_automatic_immersive_armors_: Import this rank's default Immersive Armors sets once under the global equipment integration switch, preserving custom sets/weights, empty pools and receipts.
roamer._说明_allow_tacz_firearms_中文: 允许本阶自动配枪；关闭后仍可由玩家手动配枪，不关闭全局TaCZ兼容。
roamer._description_allow_tacz_firearms_en: Allow automatic firearm provisioning for this rank; players can still supply guns, and global TaCZ integration remains.
roamer._说明_weapon_count_中文: 出生武器名额概率；流浪者最多2件，其他阶最多3件，手持和背包远程/近战均计入；不限制后续拾取和主人配装。
roamer._description_weapon_count_en: Spawn weapon slot probabilities; Roamers cap at 2, other ranks at 3, counting held/backpack melee and ranged gear. Later looting and owner equipment are not capped.

weapon_count._说明_second_weapon_chance_中文: 生成第二件武器的概率，0–0.49；已有远程武器计入总数。
weapon_count._description_second_weapon_chance_en: Chance of another weapon slot, 0–0.49; existing ranged weapons count toward the cap.
weapon_count._说明_third_weapon_chance_中文: 生成第三件武器的概率，0–0.49；已有远程武器计入总数。
weapon_count._description_third_weapon_chance_en: Chance of another weapon slot, 0–0.49; existing ranged weapons count toward the cap.

roamer._说明_automatic_shield_enchantments_中文: 允许出生盾牌自动附魔；条目中指定的附魔仍按装备规则。
roamer._description_automatic_shield_enchantmen: Allow automatic enchantments on spawn shields; explicit entry enchantments follow loadout rules.
roamer._说明_guaranteed_shields_min_中文: 生成时盾牌总数目标下限，0–3，含手持与背包；仅从shield_pool补足。
roamer._description_guaranteed_shields_min_en: Minimum spawn shield-count target, 0–3, including hands/backpack; supplied only from shield_pool.
roamer._说明_guaranteed_shields_max_中文: 盾牌总数目标上限，0–3；空或无效shield_pool不补原版回退盾牌。
roamer._description_guaranteed_shields_max_en: Maximum shield-count target, 0–3; empty/invalid shield_pool does not produce fallback vanilla shields.
roamer._说明_shield_pool_中文: 盾牌候选权重池；须使用合法盾牌ID，空列表不保证盾牌。
roamer._description_shield_pool_en: Weighted shield pool; use valid shield IDs. An empty list guarantees no additional shields.
roamer._说明_automatic_scguns_armor_中文: 全局装备自动导入开启时，一次性追加本阶已注册普通护甲，含普通独立头盔组合；外骨骼套装、核心和扩展模块不自动导入。不覆盖自定义条目与权重，显式空池保持为空；已有导入记录后删除的条目不补回。玩家专属额外效果不移植。
roamer._description_automatic_scguns_armor_en: When global auto-import is enabled, add registered ordinary Scorched Guns armor and helmet combinations once. Excludes ExoSuit armor, cores and modules. Preserve custom entries, weights, empty pools and prior import receipts.

tier1._description_automatic_immersive_armors_: Import this rank's default Immersive Armors sets once under the global equipment integration switch, preserving custom sets/weights, empty pools and receipts.

weapon_count._说明_second_weapon_chance_中文: 生成第二件武器的概率，0–0.49；已有远程武器计入总数。
weapon_count._description_second_weapon_chance_en: Chance of another weapon slot, 0–0.49; existing ranged weapons count toward the cap.
weapon_count._说明_third_weapon_chance_中文: 生成第三件武器的概率，0–0.49；已有远程武器计入总数。
weapon_count._description_third_weapon_chance_en: Chance of another weapon slot, 0–0.49; existing ranged weapons count toward the cap.
